scope: Registered native daemon workspace and Git execution under saved UID/HOME/cwd

hostDaemonProtocol.reason: Private workspace authority response and immutable worker IPC contract require coordinated server/daemon upgrade

commands: pnpm exec turbo run test --filter=@bb/server -- test/internal test/security test/hosts test/threads test/environments test/services/plugins/plugin-background.test.ts test/services/plugins/plugin-tool-calls.test.ts

findings.reason: Private workspace resolver wrote HTTP success headers before evaluating authority, preventing an error response on revoked access
findings.fix: Evaluate authority before writeHead; test actual socket revoke and identity injection

findings.reason: Decoding each streamed stdin chunk independently can corrupt multibyte UTF-8
findings.fix: Bound raw bytes and decode once; real Git commit test streams a large Cyrillic message across byte boundaries

findings.reason: Existing native commit intentionally uses noVerify, so a pre-commit fixture does not execute
findings.fix: Use prepare-commit-msg without changing native commit behavior; require a real descendant heartbeat before cleanup assertions

findings.reason: Full macOS test sandbox made the Unix socket pathname exceed its platform length limit, producing listen EINVAL and a pending listener Promise
findings.fix: Use a short sandbox-relative socket path and reject listen errors; retain normal timeouts

findings.reason: FRP fixture cache default points outside writable test roots
findings.fix: Use the existing BB_FRP_CACHE_DIR option with a temporary directory and Turbo loose env mode; retain all tests

findings.reason: Exact gzip byte counts depend on Node/zlib; contract baseline also expected protocol 252 before this increment
findings.fix: Keep exact JSON wire sizes, assert bounded compression and grouped savings, and explicitly test protocol 254 compatibility

findings.reason: Earlier passing deployments predated stronger native Git/descendant checks or final IPC/client fixes
findings.fix: Use one complete rebuilt deployment for final evidence; remove only its exact superseded disposable lab

limitations: Only registered native workspace paths and the four named commands are covered; arbitrary central plugins and legacy custom-provider recovery remain audited separately.
Daemon, root helper and centrally installed plugins remain trusted for assigned runtimes.
Authority polling and cancellation do not roll back completed Git/filesystem effects or provide exactly-once execution.
Process UID/namespaces are not a filesystem jail, network isolation or a total host memory quota.
Stock Qwen SDK/CLI with deterministic local backend does not verify the corporate certificate SDK contract.
No UI change; browser baseline remains increment 51.
Composite background acceptance, full machine/action audit, profile translation, project MCP, reusable agents and wider UI requirements remain open.
